places.name: Jagannath Temple (Puri)
places.ai_summary: A sacred Hindu temple dedicated to Lord Jagannath, famous for the annual Rath Yatra.

opening_hours.notes: Closed to non-Hindus.

places.place_tip: Visit during the Rath Yatra for a unique experience.

attribution.title: PURI JAGANATHA TEMPLE, PURI, ORISSA, INDIA, ASIA

attribution.description: The World Famous Lord Jagannatha Temple---------Puri--India

places.name: Konark Sun Temple
places.ai_summary: A UNESCO World Heritage Site, this 13th-century temple is dedicated to the Sun God and is known for its intricate carvings.

opening_hours.notes: Best visited during sunrise or sunset.

places.place_tip: Hire a guide to understand the temple's history and architecture.

places.name: Chilika Lake
places.ai_summary: The largest coastal lagoon in India, Chilika Lake is a hotspot for birdwatching and marine life.

opening_hours.notes: Best time to visit is from November to February.

places.place_tip: Take a boat ride to explore the lake and its islands.

attribution.title: Birds eyeview of Chilika Lake

places.name: Lingaraja Temple (Bhubaneswar)
places.ai_summary: An ancient Hindu temple dedicated to Lord Shiva, known for its exquisite architecture and carvings.

opening_hours.notes: Closed to non-Hindus.

places.place_tip: Attend the evening Aarti for a spiritual experience.

attribution.title: LINGARAJ TEMPLE AMLAN BISWAL 2024
attribution.author: AmlanBiswal25
attribution.description: Shri Lingaraja is regarded as the King of all Lingas worshipped on Earth surface.

places.name: Udayagiri and Khandagiri Caves
places.ai_summary: Ancient rock-cut caves that served as residential and meditation quarters for Jain monks.

opening_hours.notes: Best visited in the early morning or late afternoon.

places.place_tip: Explore the caves and the Jain heritage.

attribution.title: Khandagari and Udaygiri featured image
attribution.author: Government of Odisha

places.name: Dhauli Peace Pagoda
places.ai_summary: A Buddhist stupa and peace pagoda, Dhauli is a serene place associated with Emperor Ashoka.

opening_hours.notes: Visit the nearby rock edicts of Ashoka.

places.place_tip: Participate in the meditation sessions if interested.

opening_hours.notes: Best time to visit is from October to March.

places.place_tip: Try the local seafood at the beach shacks.

places.name: Nandankanan Zoological Park
places.ai_summary: A zoo and botanical garden, Nandankanan is famous for its white tigers and lush greenery.

opening_hours.notes: Closed on Mondays.

places.place_tip: Visit the reptile park and the botanical garden.

places.ai_summary: A 11th-century Hindu temple, Rajarani is known for its unique architecture and serene surroundings.

opening_hours.notes: Best visited in the early morning or late afternoon.

places.place_tip: Explore the temple complex and the gardens.

places.name: Simlipal National Park
places.ai_summary: A national park and tiger reserve, Simlipal is known for its biodiversity and scenic beauty.

opening_hours.notes: Closed on Tuesdays.

places.place_tip: Carry packed food and water, and wear comfortable shoes.

places.name: Hirakud Dam
places.ai_summary: One of the longest dams in the world, Hirakud Dam is an engineering marvel and a popular tourist spot.

opening_hours.notes: Best visited in the early morning or late afternoon.

places.place_tip: Visit the dam and the nearby Gandhi Minar.

places.name: Raghurajpur Artist Village
places.ai_summary: A heritage crafts village, Raghurajpur is famous for its Pattachitra paintings and other traditional arts.

opening_hours.notes: Best visited in the winter months.

places.place_tip: Interact with the artists and buy handicrafts as souvenirs.

places.ai_summary: A 10th-century Hindu temple, Mukteswara is known for its exquisite carvings and architectural beauty.

opening_hours.notes: Best visited in the early morning or late afternoon.

places.place_tip: Explore the intricate carvings and the temple complex.

places.name: Pipili Applique Village
places.ai_summary: Famous for its applique work, Pipili is a vibrant village where you can shop for colorful handicrafts.

opening_hours.notes: Best visited in the winter months.

places.ai_summary: A unique ecosystem, Bhitarkanika is famous for its mangrove forests and rich biodiversity.
